From today, Runna subscribers can use the new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on the temperature and humidity in the user's location. Details below.

Runna launches new training tool to help users cope with hot weather

The personalised running coach app Runna today (the 17th) announced three updates aimed at providing users with comprehensive support throughout their entire training cycle, covering every aspect from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature officially launches today, helping users find cooler running windows and recommending adjusted pace targets based on "feels-like temperature," session duration, and specific workout type.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature uses colour-coded weather forecasts for each time slot, allowing users to identify the best time to run at a glance and plan their training accordingly.

Below is Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once users start a race plan for events ranging from 5km to 50km, the system will automatically generate a corresponding recovery plan. Steph Kessell, Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury."

Lastly, the platform announced that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will be launched in August. Users can pre-arrange multiple training plans, and the system will seamlessly transition between plans, further simplifying the long-term training process.

Below are the advantages of Runna's "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can layer multiple races, mid-term goals, and training phases for a comprehensive overview of the year. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—when one plan ends and the next begins, your preferred training schedule, predicted finish times, and current fitness level all carry over automatically. Flexibility in your hands: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is carefully crafted by the Runna coaching team based on proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day performance.
